description: Minimal bidirectional title policy. Titles are identified by the title endpoint class shared with chain detection, frozen before formal Typesetting, and retypeset afterward with the same Typesetting instance in their immutable source boxes. The target-language tables resolve by longest language-tag prefix. Chinese targets require one visual line; English targets may use a finite three-line source region. Every target remains complete, at or above the configured readable scale, and overflow fails closed.
